posts.title: Bazel Is Not For You
posts.description: I know the title sounds like clickbait, but hear me out. I make a living helping people with their Bazel builds. My ability to put food on the table is directly correlated with more people using Bazel. I’ve staked my career in the fact that people need great builds, and that Bazel is a great way to get there.
